map.计算全口义齿垂直距离(VDO)、息止颌间隙(FS)与正中关系(CR)，辅助颌位记: Calculates the complete-denture vertical dimension (VDO), freeway space (FS) and centric relation (CR) to assist jaw-relation recording and articulator mounting.
map.📖 查看「全口义齿（颌位关系）转移器 使用指南」: View "Complete Denture (Jaw Relation) Transfer Tool User Guide"
map.⚠️ 颌位关系是全口义齿成败关键。垂直距离过高致肌肉疲劳、过低致面容苍老；正中关: Jaw relation is the key to complete-denture success. Too-high vertical dimension causes muscle fatigue; too-low makes the face look aged; centric relation must be stable and reproducible.
map.垂直距离 VDO = 息止垂直距离 VDR - 息止颌间隙 FS\n正常息止颌间:
Vertical dimension VDO = rest vertical dimension VDR - freeway space FS
Normal freeway space: 2 - 4 mm

Empirical reference:
  pupil-to-mouth distance approx nasion-to-menton distance (VDO)
  in the elderly VDR slightly decreases with dentition wear/extraction
map.参考：修复学（全口义齿）颌位关系记录章节。: Reference: Prosthodontics (complete denture) jaw-relation recording section.
map.📚 深度解析：全口义齿（颌位关系）转移器: In-Depth: Complete Denture (Jaw Relation) Transfer Tool
map.无牙颌取颌位，测量息止位与笑位，工具由息止颌间隙反推正常垂直距离(VDO)。: For edentulous jaw relation taking, measure the rest and smile positions; the tool back-calculates the normal vertical dimension (VDO) from the freeway space.
map.旧义齿重做，对比旧义齿垂直距离与面部比例，确定新的恢复目标。: For remaking an old denture, compare its vertical dimension with facial proportions to set a new restoration goal.
map.确定正中关系(CR)后转入合架，保证人工牙排列与咬合稳定。（结果仅供口腔健康科普: After establishing centric relation (CR), transfer to the articulator to ensure stable artificial-tooth arrangement and occlusion. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical film/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis and treatment by dental, orthodontic or periodontal specialists; if you have toothache, gum bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, please visit a regular hospital dental department promptly.)
map.输入：息止颌位面下 1/3 = 70mm，息止颌间隙 FS = 3mm\n计算：:
Input: rest-position lower-face-third = 70mm, freeway space FS = 3mm
Calculation: normal vertical dimension VDO = rest position - FS = 70 - 3 = 67mm
Note: restoring VDO relates to speech, facial appearance and masticatory support; combine with facial proportions.
map.VDO 和 FS 什么关系？: What is the relationship between VDO and FS?
map.VDO（垂直距离）由息止颌位减去息止颌间隙(FS，约 2~4mm)获得，是排牙与: VDO (vertical dimension) is obtained by subtracting the freeway space FS (about 2-4mm) from the rest position; it is the baseline for arranging teeth and restoring lower-face height.
map.下颌对上颌在铰链位的最后退接触关系，是全口义齿稳定咬合的参考位，与正中颌位可能不: The rearmost retruded contact relation of the mandible to the maxilla at the hinge position; a reference position for stable complete-denture occlusion, which may differ from centric occlusion.
map.能自己定垂直距离吗？: Can I set the vertical dimension myself?
map.不能。垂直距离过低/过高都会影响咀嚼与关节，须由修复科医师结合面容、发音与肌力确: No. Too-low or too-high vertical dimension affects mastication and the joint; it must be set by a prosthodontist combining facial appearance, speech and muscle force.
